text: Arthur Danto introduced the notion of a 'basic action' in order to:
choices: Prove that free will is an illusion
Show that all actions are ultimately reflexes
Halt a regress by identifying actions not performed by doing anything else
Deny that intentions ever cause actions
explanation: Danto introduced 'basic actions' - actions not performed by doing anything else - to stop a regress (I raise my arm, but not by first doing something more basic). Options 0, 1, and 3 misattribute to the notion claims about free will, reflexes, or a denial of mental causation.
